description.value:
Duration constant

When you critically succeed at RUST TOUCH, the corrosion spreads to one creature adjacent to the target, which suffers the same -1 item penalty to its worn armor or held metal weapon until repaired. The spread copies the base penalty, not the critical one, and does not spread again from there.

cinderfall.incomplete: On a RUST TOUCH crit, spreads the same item penalty to an adjacent creature -- ItemAlteration only alters items owned by the same actor the rule element's item belongs to (confirmed against pf2e-source's item-alteration/ rule elements); no rule element alters a second hostile creature's own gear either (NOFOREIGN-ITEM, doubled).
